edges.reason: msg.sender owns the balance debited by RESTOToken.transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked in RESTOToken.transferFrom.
msg.sender is forwarded as beneficiary into buyTokens.
confirmOwnership accepts ownership whenever candidate == msg.sender, giving the caller unilateral control.
transferOwnership authorisation depends on msg.sender == owner.
setManager authorisation depends on msg.sender == owner.
kycPass only executes when msg.sender equals the CrowdsaleAddress.
transferTokensFromSpecialAddress is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
token.pause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
token.unpause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
pauseCrowdsale is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
unpauseCrowdsale is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setKYCpassed is gated by the restricted modifier on msg.sender.
transferTokensFromTeamAddress1 is gated by restricted on msg.sender.
transferTokensFromTeamAddress2 is gated by restricted on msg.sender.
transferTokensFromMarketingAddress is gated by restricted on msg.sender.
transferTokensFromRetailersAddress is gated by restricted on msg.sender.
transferTokensFromReserveAddress is gated by restricted on msg.sender.
transferTokensFromBountyAddress is gated by restricted on msg.sender.
transferTokens is gated by restricted on msg.sender.
withdrawFunds is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
The isICOover modifier blocks transfers based on now versus crowdSaleEndTime, making transfer availability timestamp dependent.
The isICOover modifier blocks transferFrom based on block.timestamp.
TeamAddress2 unlocks only when now >= crowdSaleEndTime + 365 days.
Purchase validity depends on now being inside the sale window or past the pause timestamp.
Bonus tiers in _getTokenAmount are selected purely from block.timestamp comparisons.
withdrawFunds requires now > crowdSaleEndTime before releasing funds.
Crowdsale fallback invokes buyTokens(msg.sender).
buyTokens calls _preValidatePurchase before pricing.
buyTokens calls _getTokenAmount to price the purchase.
buyTokens calls _processPurchase to deliver tokens.
_processPurchase delegates token delivery to _deliverTokens.
transferTokens calls _deliverTokens after scaling the amount.
_deliverTokens performs an external token call before the caller finishes its state accounting, allowing a malicious token to re-enter.
withdrawFunds makes an external ETH transfer to a caller-supplied address before emitting the event.
forwardFunds pushes ETH to eight external addresses in sequence, re-entering if any recipient is a contract.
pauseCrowdsale performs an external call into token.pause().
unpauseCrowdsale performs an external call into token.unpause().
setKYCpassed forwards the KYC flag to token.kycPass.
transferTokensFromTeamAddress1 calls transferTokensFromSpecialAddress on the token.
transferTokensFromTeamAddress2 calls transferTokensFromSpecialAddress on the token.
transferTokensFromMarketingAddress calls transferTokensFromSpecialAddress on the token.
transferTokensFromRetailersAddress calls transferTokensFromSpecialAddress on the token.
transferTokensFromReserveAddress calls transferTokensFromSpecialAddress on the token.
transferTokensFromBountyAddress calls transferTokensFromSpecialAddress on the token.
_burnFrom deducts the allowance and then calls _burn.
_getTokenAmount composes bonus percentage and rate multiplications/divisions that must not overflow.
The Crowdsale constructor distributes initial supply through _deliverTokens.
RESTOToken.transfer delegates to the base ERC20 transfer implementation.
RESTOToken.transferFrom delegates to the base ERC20 transferFrom implementation.
transferTokensFromSpecialAddress subtracts and adds scaled values into the balances_ mapping.
_mint increases totalSupply_ with SafeMath.add.
_mint increases the recipient balance in balances_.
_burn decreases totalSupply_ with SafeMath.sub.
_burn decreases the account balance in balances_.
_burnFrom decreases the spender allowance in allowed_.
buyTokens accumulates msg.value into weiRaised.
kycPass writes true into the kyc mapping.
pause sets the paused flag to true.
unpause resets the paused flag to false.
CrowdsaleAddress is the only address allowed to execute kycPass.
The kyc_passed modifier exempts the CrowdsaleAddress from the KYC requirement in transfer.
The kyc_passed modifier exempts the CrowdsaleAddress from the KYC requirement in transferFrom.
transfer reads the kyc mapping to authorise the sender.
transferFrom reads the kyc mapping to authorise the sender.
transferOwnership compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
setManager compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
confirmOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with the candidate.
confirmOwnership requires candidate == msg.sender before promoting it.
The restricted modifier accepts the manager address for setKYCpassed.
The restricted modifier accepts the manager address for transferTokens.
The constructor reads the deployed token instance held in the token state variable.
_deliverTokens calls safeTransfer on the token state variable.
_preValidatePurchase compares the current time to crowdSaleStartTime.
_preValidatePurchase compares the current time to crowdSaleEndTime.
transferTokensFromTeamAddress2 derives its lock period from crowdSaleEndTime.
The isICOover modifier uses the token crowdSaleEndTime to gate transfers.
The isICOover modifier uses the token crowdSaleEndTime to gate transferFrom.
_preValidatePurchase checks weiRaised against hardCap.
weiRaised is compared with hardCap during validation.
_getTokenAmount multiplies the result amount by the rate state variable.
INITIAL_SUPPLY is minted through _mint in the token constructor.
Parameter _to of RESTOToken.transfer is validated by validDestination.
Parameter _value of RESTOToken.transfer is compared with the sender balance.
Parameter _from of RESTOToken.transferFrom supplies the debited account.
Parameter _to of RESTOToken.transferFrom is validated by validDestination.
Parameter _value of RESTOToken.transferFrom is checked against balance and allowance.

Parameter _value of transferTokensFromTeamAddress1 determines the amount moved.
Parameter _beneficiary of _preValidatePurchase is checked against address(0).
Parameter _weiAmount of _preValidatePurchase is checked against zero.
Parameter _newInvestor of transferTokens is the delivery target.
Parameter _tokenAmount of transferTokens is scaled by 1 ether.

Parameter _account of _mint receives the minted amount.

Local weiAmount takes msg.value and feeds validation and pricing.
Local tokens is passed into _processPurchase for delivery.
Local value is scaled by 1 ether before balance comparison and subtraction.
Local value is scaled by 1 ether before being delivered.
Local bonus participates in the multiplications that compute the token amount.
Local resultAmount is multiplied by rate and returned to buyTokens.
Local transferValue is derived from the contract balance divided by 8.
Local totalTokens from the constructor is split across the special addresses via _deliverTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists to feed the validDestination check and balance update inside RESTOToken.transfer.
The _value parameter is only consumed by the transfer require and SafeMath arithmetic.
The _from parameter is only used to index balances_ inside transferFrom.
The _to parameter is only used for the destination validation and credit in transferFrom.
The _value parameter is only consumed by the allowance and balance checks in transferFrom.
The _beneficiary parameter only drives validation and delivery inside buyTokens.
The _investor parameter is only forwarded to token.kycPass from setKYCpassed.
The _investor parameter is only used as the recipient inside transferTokensFromTeamAddress1.
The _value parameter is only forwarded to transferTokensFromSpecialAddress.
The _beneficiary parameter is only checked against address(0) in _preValidatePurchase.
The _weiAmount parameter is only checked for non-zero value in _preValidatePurchase.
The _newInvestor parameter is only used as the delivery target in transferTokens.
The _tokenAmount parameter is only scaled and delivered in transferTokens.
The _to parameter is the untrusted destination of the ETH transfer in withdrawFunds.
The _value parameter is only compared with the balance and transferred in withdrawFunds.
The _account parameter is only used as the minting destination in _mint.
The _amount parameter is only added to totalSupply_ and balances_ in _mint.
The weiAmount local is a short-lived alias of msg.value used only inside buyTokens.
The tokens local is produced in buyTokens solely to be consumed by _processPurchase.
The value local is an intermediate scaling variable used only inside transferTokensFromSpecialAddress.
The value local is an intermediate scaling variable used only inside Crowdsale.transferTokens.
The bonus local exists only to accumulate the timestamp tier inside _getTokenAmount.
The resultAmount local is the accumulator returned by _getTokenAmount.
The transferValue local is the per-wallet split computed inside forwardFunds.
The totalTokens local is read once and immediately distributed through _deliverTokens.
